Cozy, Inviting, Great Drinks and Vibes
Aug 2026 • Friends
I found this place with my cousin after eating mi vit tiem right across the street. It's seated amongst many good food in the area. I went in out of curiosity and was super surprised how cozy and inviting it was. It was just the two of us and a few hours before closing time at Sunday night so we got a more personalized experience. Bartender was also a great English speaker and very hilarious (I'm Viet American and can speak both languages but more comfy in English so this helped a lot) and recommended me great drinks. Drinks are fairly priced for the area and awesome. Like I said it was just my cousin and I so no long wait time at all. 

I still think about this bar a lot and wish I could go back. Highly recommend stopping here after a long day if you're in the Mekong Delta!!! Also try the duck noodles across the street they're also great haha!

A pocket of paradise
Jun 2026 • Solo
Loving this little piece of paradise. Great place to chill during the day for a coffee and bite to eat, or for a harder drink and dinner. Great food. Mr Dat and Ms Luna have worked hard to create a wonderful atmosphere serving good quality drinks and delicious food. Mr Trung and Ms Bong (no not like that) also ensure you are getting what you want. I have been coming here nearly every 10 days since I stumbled upon this welcoming watering hole. This is not a rowdy pub and it is not an exclusive nightclub. You can sit at the bar and chat, or one of the tables downstairs or even head upstairs.
If you see me at the bar say hi 'cause I might just be there when you visit ... hahaha.

Noise level
Quiet, easy to talk

Group size
Suitable for all group sizes

Seating type
Indoor dining area, Bar area, Counter seating

Vegetarian options
A few dishes. Just chat to the staff and they will confirm.

Dietary restrictions
Speak with Mr Dat and he will work it out if possible.Parking space
Somewhat difficult to find parking

Parking options
Free of charge street parking

Parking
Parking availability will depend on the time you are there. Street parking can be a bit tricky in the Ninh Kieu Quay area, otherwise you can find a paid parking spot for 5-10k (usually). Be careful if you have parked in front of another shop as they will get a bit agro... just not done.

Kid-friendliness
During the day, Coco is more of a cafe so can get coffee or cocktails. At night, I wouldn't expect to see kids, but if you must, please ensure they are being well behaved.

Wheelchair accessibility
There is no ramp from the street into the bar area, and the restroom is upstairs.
